# Country scope. True for living non-rebel Roman Empire (BYZ or ROM).
oe_mag_is_roman_empire = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        tag = ROM
    }
}

# Country scope. True for core Maghreb dynasty powers (Morocco, Tunis, Tlemcen [TLE], Algiers [ALG]).
oe_mag_is_maghreb_power = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = MOR
        tag = TUN
        tag = TLE
        tag = ALG
        owns = location:fez
        owns = location:tunis
        owns = location:tlemcen
    }
}

# Country scope. True for West African gold powers (Mali [MAL], Songhai [SON], or holder of Niani/Timbuktu/Gao).
oe_mag_is_west_africa_power = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = MAL
        tag = SON
        owns = location:niani
        owns = location:timbuktu
        owns = location:gao
    }
}

# Country scope. Muslim power holding a core Barbary corsair port (algiers / tunis / tripoli).
oe_mag_is_muslim_corsair_power = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    religion.group = religion_group:muslim
    OR = {
        owns = location:algiers
        owns = location:tunis
        owns = location:tripoli
        tag = ALG
        tag = TUN
        tag = TLE
        tag = MOR
    }
}

# Any scope. True when Muslim Ottoman Empire (c:TUR) exists and is not root (for Barbary patronage option).
oe_mag_ottoman_patron_alive = {
    country_exists = c:TUR
    c:TUR = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        religion.group = religion_group:muslim
    }
    NOT = { tag = TUR }
}

# Country scope. True when root (BYZ/ROM) or its subject controls location:tunis (has_owner guarded).
oe_mag_roman_controls_tunis = {
    OR = {
        owns = location:tunis
        location:tunis = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = { is_subject_of = root }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. True when root (BYZ/ROM) or its subject holds any major North African hub (has_owner guarded).
oe_mag_roman_holds_north_africa = {
    OR = {
        oe_mag_roman_controls_tunis = yes
        owns = location:tripoli
        owns = location:fez
        owns = location:algiers
        location:tripoli = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_subject_of = root } }
        location:algiers = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_subject_of = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Safe region-level presence check across Maghreb/Sahel/Guinea (every tile checks has_owner = yes first!).
oe_mag_has_african_region_presence = {
    OR = {
        region:maghreb_region = { any_location_in_region = { has_owner = yes owner = root } }
        region:sahel_region = { any_location_in_region = { has_owner = yes owner = root } }
        region:guinea_region = { any_location_in_region = { has_owner = yes owner = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. True when BYZ/ROM has organized Africa Diocese (oe_prf_dio_10), Prefecture III (oe_prf_mode_3), or an Exarchate subject.
oe_mag_has_prf_africa = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_prf_dio_10
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_dio_10 } var:oe_prf_dio_10 >= 1 }
        }
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_prf_mode_3
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_mode_3 } var:oe_prf_mode_3 >= 1 }
        }
        any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ar_exarchate }
    }
}

# Any scope. True when African Romanization movement has started (couples with fx23 oe_roman_assimilation).
oe_mag_africa_assim_active = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_rw_africa_romanization_started }
}

# Country scope. Fast O(1) gate for oe_mag_pulse.txt fallback pulse (strictly fx17 rebel-guarded).
oe_mag_pulse_host_candidate = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = MOR
        tag = TUN
        tag = TLE
        tag = ALG
        tag = MAL
        tag = SON
        tag = BYZ
        tag = ROM
        AND = {
            is_ai = no
            OR = {
                owns = location:tunis
                owns = location:algiers
                owns = location:fez
                owns = location:timbuktu
                owns = location:tripoli
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Live non-rebel host checks for each theater global pointer.
oe_mag_has_live_maghreb_host = {
    has_global_variable = oe_mag_host_maghreb
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_host_maghreb }
        country_exists = global_var:oe_mag_host_maghreb
        global_var:oe_mag_host_maghreb = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
}
